about.title: Purposeful design, from idea to screen.
body: I’m Johan Yanten, a multidisciplinary designer from Universidad Diego Portales. I work across branding, information design, interfaces and video.
I like turning complex things into clear ones: data you can feel, brands with personality and interfaces that need no instructions.
